abstract: Previous studies have suggested an association between subfertility and testicular cancer by using fecundity and semen characteristics to measure fertility. The occurrence of twinning in offspring may be used to investigate male reproductive health, because dizygotic twinning is reduced by male subfertility. We therefore assessed number of children and offspring twinning rates among 4592 Swedish patients with testicular cancer and 12 254 control subjects. Before diagnosis, case patients had a decreased number of children (for testicular cancer, odds ratio [OR] = 0.71, 95% confidence interval [CI] = 0.62 to 0.81; at least three children compared with no children), with a lower frequency of dizygotic twinning (for unlike-sex twins, OR for the father having testicular cancer = 0.49, 95% CI = 0.22 to 1.08). The ratio of unlike-sex to same-sex twins was 0.22 among children of case patients and 0.66 among children of control subjects (adjusted P =.03, two-sided Wald test). We also found an increased occurrence of twinning after diagnosis, probably attributable to treatment for iatrogenic subfertility. Our study strongly supports evidence of an association between subfertility and the subsequent risk for testicular cancer.
abstract_ja:
以前の研究では、不妊と精巣がんの関連が示唆されており、妊孕性の指標として妊娠率と精液特性が用いられてきた。二卵性双生児の出生は男性の不妊によって減少するため、双生児出生率は男性の生殖健康を調べる手段となりうる。そこで我々は、スウェーデンの精巣がん患者4592例と対照12254例について、子どもの数と子の双生児出生率を評価した。
診断前、症例では子どもの数が少なかった(精巣がんに対するオッズ比[OR]=0.71、95%信頼区間[CI]=0.62～0.81；子どもが3人以上と子どもなしの比較)。二卵性の異性双生児の頻度も低かった(父親が精巣がんの場合の異性双生児のOR=0.49、95%CI=0.22～1.08)。異性双生児と同性双生児の比は、症例の子どもで0.22、対照の子どもで0.66であった(調整P=.03、両側Wald検定)。診断後には双生児出生の増加も認められ、これは治療による医原性の不妊に起因すると考えられる。
本研究は、不妊と将来の精巣がんリスクとの関連を強く支持するものである。
